aria: Animated recap of the Thunder's 114 to 75 home win over Washington: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 27-foot step-back three with 4:38 left in the third quarter, quarter-by-quarter scoring, his 30 points and 9 assists, the top scorers, how the Thunder won, and the next game at Portland.
notes: Box score from the Thunder's 114–75 home win over the Washington Wizards on Nov 7, 2026, from Covers.com's full box score, with team stats (points in the paint, bench and fast-break points), biggest leads and play-by-play from Plain Text Sports, and game details from the AP (via WRAL, CBS Sports and News9), Reuters/Field Level Media (via The Sports Animal), The Oklahoman (via Yahoo Sports) and Yardbarker. All 114 points are accounted for in the box score. The league stats feed wasn't available for this recap, so records come from the site's standings through Nov 6 plus Saturday's results (Oklahoma City 8–2; Portland 6–3 after losing to San Antonio).

Biggest leads: Oklahoma City's 43 (Plain Text Sports and The Oklahoman) and Washington's 1 (16–15 late in the first quarter, per Field Level Media and Plain Text Sports). The Thunder play at Portland on Tuesday at 11:00 PM ET (Yardbarker; The Oklahoman lists 10 p.m. Central).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 27-foot step-back three with 4:38 left in the third quarter, which made it 76–54 (the AP gives the time and score; Plain Text Sports' play-by-play describes the step-back and distance). The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Oklahoma City Thunder or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to Gilgeous-Alexander’s listed 6-foot-6 and 195 pounds (Basketball-Reference), with arms scaled to his reported 7-foot wingspan (Sports Illustrated's 2018 draft scouting report). It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
